messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the chat-stream postmortem — doing a closure sweep. Can owners confirm status for items below? TL;DR: timeouts, partial responses, reconnect jitter. I'll collect and escalate if anything slips past EOW.

maria: Action list (brief):
• aj — reconnect jitter fix + canary
• owen — streaming proxy timeout tuning + alerting
• sophia — investigate partial responses (KV cache/tokenization)
• sam — add CI smoke/regression for streaming
• leah — customer comms + impact notes
• all — add ETA (date) or :raised_hand: if blocked

maria: Relevant links: postmortem doc https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-114, runbook https://kb.redwood/runbooks/streaming-chat.

aj: I'm owning the reconnect jitter. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/engine/pulls/452 — landed yesterday. Canary deploy scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. Will add a short dashboard for canary metrics.

aj: Quick note: tuned client backoff to use jittered exponential with max_interval=10s, retries=6. Example config we pushed:```json
{"backoff": "exp_jitter", "base_ms": 200, "max_ms": 10000, "max_retries": 6}```

owen: Timeout work in progress. Increased proxy streaming timeout from 30s -> 65s for the streaming route to reduce premature cutoffs. Monitoring effect now. Added metric: `streaming.proxy_timeout_rate`. Will revert if CPU/queued-requests spike.

owen: I'll wire an alert: `alert: streaming_partial_response_rate > 0.5% for 5m` and a dashboard panel for `avg_stream_latency_p50/p95`.

sophia: Partial responses root cause update: reproduced locally — tokenization mismatch between quantized model loader and client-side tokenizer causing early EOS tokens in ~0.04% of calls. Working on a compatibility shim and a test harness. ETA Thursday EOD. PR coming.

sophia: Also adding a small check to the model onboarding pipeline that rejects model artifacts with mismatched vocab metadata.

sam: I'll add a streaming smoke test to CI that runs a 30s streaming session and asserts no early EOF/partial messages. Filed INF-789: https://tickets.redwood/INF-789. ETA: Friday AM.
sam: CI snippet I plan to add:```yaml
jobs:
  streaming-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: make smoke-stream-test --timeout 60s
```

leah: Product/CS update: top-3 impacted customers have been notified, summary sent to CSMs. No major SLA breaches expected after timeouts tweak but we'll keep them posted.

incident-bot: Linked incident INC-2026-114 to this thread and the postmortem. Reminder: owners, please update status in the incident tracker and add :white_check_mark: when complete.

maria: Can folks add a clear completion date here (iso date) so I can close the follow-ups? If we need a quick sync I'll schedule a 1hr check-in Friday.

aj: Will update PR with canary metrics + expected roll timeline. Completion date: 2025-11-21.

owen: Alert and timeout tuning deployed to canary. Moving to prod today if canary looks clean. Completion date: 2025-11-20.

sophia: Patch PR: https://git.redwood/infer/models/pulls/118 — awaiting review, ETA 2025-11-21 EOD.

sam: CI job added to staging pipeline, queued for merge. Completion date: 2025-11-21.

maria: Great — if no blockers other than sophia's PR, I'll mark actions as on-track and capture these dates in the postmortem doc. If anything slips, ping me directly or @maria. Thanks all :pray:

leah: Noted, I'll update customer notes after prod deploy and share the final incident summary.

maria: Closing sweep for now. Will reopen thread if any regression appears.
